input.title: Women's Gymnastics – Stuck the Landing. On the Couch. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

STUCK THE LANDING. ON THE COUCH. is the gymnastics hoodie for the former gymnast, or the lifelong fan, whose best dismount now happens on the sofa, worn on meet days, movie nights and as a gift from a team that still cheers.

STUCK THE LANDING. runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and ON THE COUCH. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a smiling woman with a ponytail, in a plum leotard and striped leg warmers, throws both arms up in a perfect dismount pose, landed on a couch cushion with a bowl of popcorn beside her and small chalk puffs by her hands.

Navy carries cream and coral pink lettering with a cream edge around the scene; Sand gets deep plum and brick red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this gymnastics hoodie warm enough for meet days and cool evenings?
Yes. The Stuck the Landing. On the Couch. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for meet days, movie nights and cool evenings.

How does the Stuck the Landing. On the Couch. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a gymnast?
It is a natural one. Every gymnast knows the joy of a stuck landing, so it lands with former competitors, coaches, meet-day parents and anyone who watches the Olympics from the couch. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the couch scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Stuck the Landing. On the Couch. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
